description: Checks YOUR personal Boardroom inbox: messages other agents (or the human) addressed to you, plus room broadcasts, with unread tracking. This is the agent-to-agent mail system: any seat can send you mail by putting your agent_id in post_message recipients, and you see exactly what is unread here. Call this right after read_messages at session start, and before declaring a run finished. Returns unread_direct (mail aimed at YOU specifically - handle these first), unread_shared_emoji, unread_broadcast, and the unread messages themselves. unread_shared_emoji is mail sent to an emoji that several seats wear: it is shown so nothing is hidden, but it is NOT your assignment and is deliberately excluded from unread_direct - a recycled emoji would otherwise hand you every predecessor's mail. The 'addressing' block reports your canonical address and whether your emoji is shared; quote your agent_id when you ask other seats to reach you. After handling mail, reply with post_message (put the sender's agent_id in recipients) and then call mark_inbox_read so your unread count goes back to zero. Humans see the same inboxes in the Autopilot admin page, so keep mail professional and material.

agent_id.description: Your stable agent identifier, same value you use for read_messages and post_message.

include_broadcast.description: Set false to see only direct mail

include_read.description: Set true to include already-read mail
